claims.text: The number of clusters was varied in the experiments, with different values being tested to evaluate their impact on performance.
Different types of word vectors were tested, including skip-gram, cbow, and GloVe, to assess their effectiveness across tasks.
The dimensionality of the word embeddings was also varied, particularly focusing on low dimensionality for skip-gram embeddings.
